properties.name: dialog_locked
properties.value: Halt! Only a true hero may cross. Defeat the Goblin Chief, the Mine Guard and the Lake Spirit first.

properties.name: dialog_open
properties.value: You did it, hero. The bridge is yours. The Dark King waits on the island.

properties.name: dialog
properties.value: The new palace will be ready... one day.

properties.name: dialog
properties.value: Welcome, traveler! The capital is just down the road.

properties.name: dialog
properties.value: Goblins burnt the east farms. Someone must stop their chief.

properties.name: dialog
properties.value: The ruins on the island are older than the kingdom.

properties.name: dialog
properties.value: The farms are south. Watch out for wolves at night.

properties.name: dialog
properties.value: The Dark King has woken on the south-east island. Stop him, hero.

properties.name: dialog
properties.value: Have you seen a yellow duck? It holds great power.

properties.name: dialog
properties.value: The Great Bridge connects us to the lake district.

properties.name: dialog
properties.value: The Mine Guard does not let anyone in anymore.

properties.name: dialog
properties.value: Strange noises come from the lake at night.
